subject: health
concept: Final mastery check and reflection on the complete K-12 health journey, confirming readiness for independent lifelong wellness
source_inspiration: original content — cumulative capstone review, not sourced from any single external curriculum

exercise.pictorial: Student reviews a timeline of their own health journey from first hygiene habits through capstone lifelong wellness
exercise.abstract: Student completes a comprehensive capstone assessment drawing on hygiene, nutrition, movement, mental/emotional wellness, safety, health literacy, and public health, and reflects in writing on their growth across the full K-12 sequence

assessment.mastery_threshold: 8/10 correct across mixed capstone question types, plus a passing independent wellness plan and reflection
misconception_flags: any capstone-unit misconception flag from 01-07 recurring at this stage

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
next_node_on_fail: HEALTH.G12.CAPSTONE_LIFELONG_WELLNESS.REVIEW (targeted remediation, routes to specific failed sub-node)
